label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows. Navigation uses the same size with slightly tighter tracking.

shadows.name: leaf-shadow
shadows.purpose: Only the hanging leaf. It places the glass in the air in front of the page.

motion.name: leaf-sway
motion.purpose: The hanging leaf. Stops when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

motion.name: projection-drift
motion.purpose: The faint leaf light behind the page. Stops when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only action. Aged Copper outline, no fill, Playfair. The page defines no hover or focus style.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #b68235; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #b68235; text-decoration: none; font-family: "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The same copper words with the border removed. The class exists. The current page does not use it.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #b68235; text-decoration: none; font-family: "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: The piece link. It names the piece and the outcome, and underlines itself with a hairline.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-block; padding-bottom: 0.25rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #201f1d; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(32, 31, 29, 0.35); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Playfair wordmark and tracked uppercase links on a blurred sheet of Warm Paper.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.375rem 1.5rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, #f2efe8 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-wordmark { font-family: "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #201f1d; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-nav-links a { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(32, 31, 29, 0.66); text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Label
components.description: An uppercase eyebrow. The accent form is Burnished Ochre and is reserved for sequence numbers.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(32, 31, 29, 0.66); } .ds-eyebrow-accent { color: #7d5411; }

components.name: Image Well
components.description: A square-cornered 4:5 frame. The wash shows only before the photograph covers it.
components.css: .ds-image-well { width: 100%; max-width: 280px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: rgba(127, 127, 127, 0.08); overflow: hidden; }

components.name: Footer
components.description: A Deep Ink slab. The wordmark switches to Paper on Ink.
components.css: .ds-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 1.5rem; background: #201f1d; padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem; } .ds-footer-brand { margin: 0; font-family: "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #e8e4da; } .ds-footer-link { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(232, 228, 218, 0.72); text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Projected Leaf
components.description: The leaf silhouette. On the page it is fixed, blurred 15px, and held near 0.05 opacity. This snippet shows the form at full strength so the shape is visible.
components.css: .ds-leaf { width: 120px; height: auto; filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 14px rgba(60, 56, 40, 0.16)); }

narrative.overview:
The Studio Window is a warm, quiet studio where natural light passes through stained glass and the maker's work is given space to be the focus. The locked mood is warm, luminous, and unhurried.

The page is sparse. Photographs are large, sections are padded generously, and a screen holds one idea at a time. Playfair Display carries the wordmark and the headlines at regular weight. Inter carries reading text and the small uppercase labels. Controls are few, and the one button is a thin copper outline.

Depth is restrained: a translucent header, a solid dark footer, and a single soft shadow under the hanging leaf. A faint colored light, the projection of that leaf, sits behind the page and is not a second palette for interface elements. This system refuses marketplace chrome, a cold white gallery, and craft-fair clutter.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Paper ground and Deep Ink type
Aged Copper for the action, Burnished Ochre for small labels
Playfair Display for display type, Inter for reading and labels
Flat surfaces, with one shadow reserved for the hanging leaf
Large rectangular photographs and very few controls

rules.name: The Two Metals Rule
rules.body: Aged Copper is the only action color. Burnished Ochre marks small labels and sequence numbers. Neither color fills a background.

rules.name: The Paper Ground Rule
rules.body: The page sits on Warm Paper. Pure white is not the ground of this system.

rules.name: The Regular Weight Rule
rules.body: Display, headlines, and titles are Playfair Display at weight 400. Size carries the emphasis. Bold is not the voice of this system.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat. The translucent header, the solid footer, and the leaf's single soft shadow are the whole depth system. Decorative card shadows are out.

rules.name: The Single Radius Rule
rules.body: The only corner radius is 4px, and it belongs to the button. Photographs, panels, and the page itself stay square.

dos: Do set the page on Warm Paper, with Deep Ink for the wordmark and for the footer slab.
Do set display type in Playfair Display at weight 400, and reading type in Inter.
Do use Aged Copper only for the action, as a 1px outline with 4px corners and no fill.
Do use Burnished Ochre only for small labels and sequence numbers.
Do keep photographs large, rectangular, and unrounded.
Do reserve the single drop shadow for the hanging leaf.
Do keep motion slow, leaf 8.5s and projection 10.5s, and stop it when the visitor prefers reduced motion.
donts: Don't use marketplace chrome: star ratings, badges, dense product cards, or urgency labels.
Don't use a cold gallery: a pure white ground and thin black type.
Don't use craft-fair clutter: script fonts, floral borders, or extra hues.
Don't fill the button, and don't add a second action color.
Don't put drop shadows on cards, panels, or buttons.
Don't round photographs, or invent a radius other than 4px.
